content.title: Predictive judgment, continuity baselines, and earned deference in elite sport selection
content.abstract: Elite sport selection is usually treated as expert evaluation, but it is also prediction. Coaches, selectors, high-performance directors, and selection panels make future-facing judgments about readiness, potential, and expected performance, and those judgments can control access to scarce athlete opportunity. This article distinguishes process compliance from the predictive component of decision quality.
